decision.reasoning_trace: In this session, I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers across various price points and form factors. My consideration set included a mix of highly popular budget options (EWA), premium-brand renewed units (JBL), and niche aesthetic/functional designs (Rerii wood radio, COLSUR clock-speaker). I ultimately chose the INSMY Portable Bluetooth Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) because it offers the best balance of features for its price ($29.99), including 20W output, IPX7 waterproofing, and a high rating of 4.6 based on over 6,500 reviews. While the EWA is a great ultra-portable option, the INSMY's higher wattage and floating design make it more versatile for outdoor use. The JBL Renewed was a strong contender but lost out due to recent reviews mentioning battery failures in refurbished units.
